message.content: {"question": "If a = -kv², where k is a constant, determine v(t) and x(t) given the initial conditions: x(0) = 0 and v(0) = v₀", "options": {"A": "x(t) = ln(v₀kt - 1)/k, v(t) = v₀/(v₀kt + 1)", "B": "x(t) = ln(v₀kt + 1)/k, v(t) = v₀/(v₀kt + 1)", "C": "x(t) = ln(v₀kt + 1)/k, v(t) = v₀/(v₀kt + 1)", "D": "x(t) = e^(-kt)/k - t + 1/k, v(t) = e^(-kt) - 1"}, "correct": "B"}
